Perfect Pixel attribution

Original author: theAmusing
Source: https://github.com/theamusing/perfectPixel
Upstream commit: 72096de5cf1bff9102687c4f89af6f62c4273a86
Version: 0.1.4
License declared MIT in upstream pyproject.toml and readme.md.
Adapted from src/perfect_pixel/perfect_pixel_noCV2.py.

Pixel Studio modifications: browser JavaScript and worker execution, arbitrary-size
Bluestein FFT, deterministic bounded cell sampling, premultiplied alpha support,
clamped full-image boundaries, fixed manual dimensions, flat Sobel peak handling,
optional palette reduction and resource limits. This is an adapted implementation,
not a claim of bit-for-bit equality with Python or an affiliation with the author.
